scope.venue: Binance USD-M Futures public aggregate trades
scope.purpose: cost-aware threshold validation before paper exposure

protocol.entry: threshold event on closed minute; next minute open
protocol.exit: first intraminute TP/SL touch, same-bar collision resolves to stop, otherwise close
protocol.base_costs: 5 bps fee + 2 bps slippage per fill
protocol.stress_costs: 10 bps fee + 5 bps slippage per fill

approval.reason: No candidate passed chronological development gates; the Laya paper log contains decisions but no simulated orders or fills.

limitations: The reference replay ends at its source archive cutoff (2026-08-31), not 2026-09-23.
The source replay uses minute aggregates and does not reconstruct a full L2 queue.
Laya was observed in paper mode but was not historically replayed through the same C++ core.
No profitability claim is made from a decision-only paper audit log.
